summary: Verified Promise.allSettled resilience layer + full 152-test regression baseline + real-endpoint smoke on preview + proposal auto-create end-to-end. Backend regression: 152 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. New iter234 smoke suite (11 tests) all green: all 10 endpoints consumed by FoodOpsPage/InventoryPage/Recipes/MenuEngineering return 200, and /api/proposals/event/{event_id} auto-creates a PROP-YYYY-NNNN proposal on fresh events. Frontend live check: login → /inventory + /recipes render without any 'error loading data' banner. Source review of FoodOpsPage.js (lines 275-307) and InventoryPage.js (lines 71-90) confirms Promise.allSettled + pick(fulfilled/rejected → fallback []) pattern is correctly applied — one broken endpoint can no longer collapse the whole page. Startup validation log confirmed: '✅ Startup validation passed: 11 cross-module helpers wired correctly'.
action_items: User must Deploy to Production so preview-only fixes (proposal_number ImportError fix, inventory/suppliers URL, Promise.allSettled resilience) reach culinary-ops-10.emergent.host — production still runs stale code that caused the original 'error loading data' report.
critical_code_review_comments: FoodOpsPage.js fetchData: setLoading(false) is only reached if no exception is thrown between allSettled and the end. Since allSettled itself never rejects and pick() is pure, this is safe today — but consider wrapping the whole body in try/finally so setLoading(false) is guaranteed even if a future setState throws.

InventoryPage.js fetchData lacks the toast.error call that FoodOpsPage has for failed sub-fetches. Silent partial-failure means ops won't know suppliers is broken. Consider adding the same toast pattern for parity.

run_regression.sh header still says '148 tests baseline' but suite is 152 tests + 1 skipped now that test_startup_validation.py is included via manual invocation. Update the echo string, or add tests/test_startup_validation.py to the TESTS array in scripts/run_regression.sh so pre-deploy hook actually runs the guard tests.
Consider adding tests/test_iter234_resilience_endpoints.py to the regression script so the real-endpoint smoke runs pre-deploy.
